explanation: Searched Mathlib for a lemma stating that the image `p.map f` of a submodule with a basis `b` equals `span R (range (f ∘ (↑) ∘ b))`. I tried name guesses (`map_eq_span`, `Basis.map_span`, `span_basis`, `Module.Basis.*span*`/`*map*`). I also grepped for the forms `map f p = span`, `span R (range (subtype ∘ b)) = ...` and `span R (Set.range fun i => (b i : _))`. Finally I read the span-related lemmas in `LinearAlgebra/Basis/{Basic,Submodule}.lean`. Mathlib has the ingredients the library's proof uses (`Basis.span_eq`, `Submodule.map_span`, `Submodule.map_top`, `LinearMap.range_comp`, `Submodule.range_subtype`). `Module.Basis.mem_submodule_iff` uses the same rewriting internally, but it only states a membership criterion. No single declaration states this equality, and combining the ingredients takes more than a one- or two-line instantiation.
